title: A -dirty ui pin passes the pin check, and fails only in CI
foundBy: agent review (session): `npm run registry:pack` on a tree with changes packs a -dirty build, and nothing stops a pin on one before CI fails on it
details: `scripts/consumer-conventions.go` accepts any exact version as the ui pin, `-dirty` ones included. `npm run registry:pack` on a tree with changes packs such a build. A pin on one installs on the machine that made it and nowhere else, since no CI ever builds that version. CI then fails with E404, long after the commit.
